text: In Morocco, the hedonist Frank Cotton buys a puzzle box, and back home in his bare attic [hooked chains tear him apart|images|weapons and tools]. When his brother Larry moves in with his wife Julia, a drop of Larry's blood on the floorboards [brings Frank back as a skinless ghoul|threat|the dead that rise]. Julia, once his lover, [lures men home from bars so he can drain them|rules|it must feed], while Larry's daughter Kirsty opens the box herself and [summons the Cenobites|origin|from another world], explorers who no longer know pain from pleasure.
